gloss: to knead, to work out, to elaborate

definitions.explanation: To work a substance by pressing and folding to make it soft and pliable.

definitions.gloss: to work out, to elaborate, to refine (a plan, strategy)
definitions.explanation: To develop or improve something through careful thought and preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る。
⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{練|ね}る。
examples.english: Add water to the flour and knead it well.

examples.japanese: あんこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焦|こ}がさない→焦がす：06677_kogasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{弱火|よわび}→弱火：08168_yowabi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{練|ね}った。
examples.english: I slowly worked the bean paste over low heat so it would not burn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}った。
examples.english: We worked out a strategy at the election headquarters.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; the thing kneaded or planned takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Sense 1 (knead):
- ⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る: knead clay
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る: knead dough

Sense 2 (work out):
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る: work out a plan
- ⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る: devise a strategy
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る: polish a text

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{捏|こ}ねる→捏ねる：06187_koneru⟧: to knead by hand (dough, clay). {練|ね}る also covers stirring a paste over heat (あんこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練|ね}る) and the figurative "work out a plan," which ⟦{捏|こ}ねる→捏ねる：06187_koneru⟧ lacks.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: practice (uses same kanji)
